verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented Honeycomb feature that generates incident summaries or AI alert context for responders. Query Assistant turns natural language into queries, the MCP server lets external agents investigate telemetry, Canvas investigations accept skills, and webhook variables fill in alert context without AI. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the summarization capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders
